name: io.github.ThatMojo/chinacarapi-mcp
title: ChinaCarAPI - Chinese used cars
description: Live used car listings from China (Dongchedi, Che168) in English, with inspection reports.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: Bearer <your ChinaCarAPI key>. Without it the server starts the OAuth flow (paste the key once in the browser).

headers.name: x-china-key
headers.description: Optional: the ChinaCarAPI key as a separate header, when Authorization carries an EnCarAPI key.
